pdftotext / Poppler — GPL-2.0-or-later source offer
==================================================

The bundled `pdftotext.exe` and MinGW runtime DLLs are distributed under the
GNU General Public License, version 2 or later (see `LICENSE`).

Corresponding source code:
- Poppler (PDF library and pdftotext utility): https://poppler.freedesktop.org/
- Poppler source releases: https://poppler.freedesktop.org/releases.html
- The exact upstream release used for this Windows build can be requested from
  the maintainer of this repository; include a written request via the
  repository issue tracker or the contact address in the repository profile.

This offer is made in connection with the distribution of the binary in this
folder and is valid for at least three years from the date of distribution.
If you redistribute this build, keep this file and `LICENSE` together with the
binary, and comply with the GPL's source-availability requirements.

The rest of dsh-plugin-corpus is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later as well; its source is
the repository containing this plugin. OfficeCLI is Apache-2.0 (see the
`vendor/officecli` folder); Apache-2.0 is compatible with GPL-3.0, and the
project's "or later" option allows that combination when required.
